column2: [intro]
I've got ideas, they whirl in my mind,
Crazy thoughts, I never unwind.
I ponder everything, even in sleep,
Reflex ideas, a whirlpool so deep.
I’ve got reflex ideas, they burst away,
In my head, they spin, oh hooray!
Whimsical thoughts, brilliant creations,
Reflex ideas, truly special sensations.
One day I dreamed of a magic toothbrush,
It cleans up and cooks with a thermal rush.
A reflex idea, that's how it works,
Surprising discoveries, like parkland quirks.
I’ve got reflex ideas, they burst away,
In my head, they spin, oh hooray!
Whimsical thoughts, brilliant creations,
Reflex ideas, truly special sensations.
[ solo ]
So listen up, let yourself be swayed,
In the world of reflex ideas, unafraid.
Life’s too short to be too serious,
Long live reflex ideas, a dazzling, wondrous rush!
[outro]
